name: minerals-oracle-x402
display_name: Critical Raw Minerals & Urban Mining Oracle
description: High-performance micro-oracle serving deterministic real-time prices, cross-exchange arbitrage spreads, and urban-mining scrap valuations for critical raw minerals (Silver, Platinum, Copper, Lithium, Nd/Dy Rare Earths).

capabilities.name: Get All Critical Mineral Quotes
capabilities.description: Returns spot prices, bid/ask, 24h change %, and multi-unit conversions for Ag, Pt, Cu, Li, and NdDy.

capabilities.name: Cross-Exchange Arbitrage Spreads
capabilities.description: Returns basis point spreads and net arbitrage margins for COMEX, LME, SMM, and LPPM pairs.

capabilities.name: Urban Mining Scrap Batch Valuation
capabilities.description: Calculates gross contained metal value, recovery rates, and net settlement after refining charges for EV Battery Black Mass, Auto Catalysts, E-Waste, and Rare Earth Magnets.

supported_scrap_categories.description: Hydrometallurgical recycling of Li-ion battery scrap (Li, Ni, Co, Mn)
Spent catalytic converter monolith scrap (Pt, Pd, Rh)
High-grade shredded circuit boards (Au, Ag, Cu)
NdFeB permanent magnet scrap (Nd, Dy, Pr)
